arguments.sql: SELECT c.has_chip, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.has_chip ORDER BY c.has_chip
arguments.explanation: Shows the fraud rate on labelled transactions broken down by whether the card has a chip, with transaction counts for each group.
assumptions: Same definition as the card-brand query: labelled transactions only, joined to cards via transactions.card_id, fraud rate as a fraction.
has_chip value 0 means no chip, 1 means chip.
